name: user on function keeps parameters and calls in execute conditions
source: fn on(owner) -> score { return owner; } score vehicle = 1; score result = 0; fn helper() { result = on(vehicle); execute if on(vehicle) == 1 { result = 2; } }
chinese: 函数 on(owner) -> 计分 { 返回 owner; } 计分 vehicle = 1; 计分 result = 0; 函数 helper() { result = on(vehicle); 执行 如果 on(vehicle) == 1 { result = 2; } }

name: execute on clause remains syntax beside a same-named user function
source: fn on(owner) -> score { return owner; } score vehicle = 1; score result = 0; query q = entity("minecraft:pig") {} fn helper() { execute as(q) on(owner) if on(vehicle) > 0 { result = on(vehicle); } }
chinese: 函数 on(owner) -> 计分 { 返回 owner; } 计分 vehicle = 1; 计分 result = 0; 查询 q = 实体("minecraft:pig") {} 函数 helper() { 执行 作为(q) 关系(主人) 如果 on(vehicle) > 0 { result = on(vehicle); } }

name: Chinese on function name is preserved in declarations and calls
source: fn 关系(主人) -> score { return 主人; } score result = 0; fn helper() { result = 关系(1); }
chinese: 函数 关系(主人) -> 计分 { 返回 主人; } 计分 result = 0; 函数 helper() { result = 关系(1); }

name: incomplete on function keeps its parameter names
source: fn on(owner) { return owner;
chinese: 函数 on(owner) { 返回 owner;

name: entity condition bodies are not query property blocks
source: score sort = 0; fn limit(value) -> score { return value; } query q = entity("minecraft:pig") { limit(1); } fn helper() { if entity(q) { sort = limit(1); } execute if entity(q) { sort = 2; } }
chinese: 计分 sort = 0; 函数 limit(value) -> 计分 { 返回 value; } 查询 q = 实体("minecraft:pig") { 上限(1); } 函数 helper() { 如果 实体(q) { sort = limit(1); } 执行 如果 实体(q) { sort = 2; } }

name: ordinary variable assignment keeps enum-like reference
source: score rarity = 0; score rare = 1; fn helper() { rarity = rare; }
chinese: 计分 rarity = 0; 计分 rare = 1; 函数 helper() { rarity = rare; }

name: Boss bar get option bypasses parameter protection
source: fn helper(value) { let v = bossbar.get("test:bar", value); return value; }
chinese: 函数 helper(value) { 令 v = Boss栏.取("test:bar", 数值); 返回 value; }

name: BOM does not hide advancement block context
source: ﻿advancement a { display { description = "D"; } }
chinese: ﻿进度 a { 展示 { 描述 = "D"; } }

name: Boss bar field bypasses parameter name protection
source: fn helper(value) { execute store.result(bossbar, "test:bar", value) { return value; } }
chinese: 函数 helper(value) { 执行 存值.结果(Boss栏, "test:bar", 值) { 返回 value; } }

name: function condition and reward property
source: if function(helper) || function(#group) {} advancement a { reward { function = helper; } }
chinese: 如果 函数条件(helper) || 函数条件(#group) {} 进度 a { 奖励 { 函数 = helper; } }

name: entity relation overrides origin keyword
source: execute as(z) on(origin) { self.add_tag("x"); }
chinese: 执行 作为(z) 关系(起源) { 自身.添加标签("x"); }

name: NBT keys and nested boolean values
source: nbt { true = true; false = false; 真 = [true, false]; 假 = { true = false; }; }
chinese: 数据 { true = 真; false = 假; 真 = [真, 假]; 假 = { true = 假; }; }

name: display description and item lore
source: item icon = item_stack("minecraft:stone") { lore = ["L"]; }; advancement a { criterion done { trigger = placed_block; } reward { function = helper; } display { icon = icon; description = "D"; frame = goal; } }
chinese: 物品 icon = 物品堆("minecraft:stone") { 描述 = ["L"]; }; 进度 a { 准则 done { 触发器 = placed_block; } 奖励 { 函数 = helper; } 展示 { 图标 = icon; 描述 = "D"; 框架 = 目标; } }

name: objective criteria and advancement criterion
source: objective obj { criteria = "dummy"; render_type = hearts; number_format = blank; } advancement a { criterion done { trigger = placed_block; } }
chinese: 目标 obj { 准则 = "dummy"; 渲染类型 = 爱心; 数字格式 = 空白; } 进度 a { 准则 done { 触发器 = placed_block; } }

name: declared name does not block store method
source: score result = 0; execute store.result(origin, obj) { result = 1; }
chinese: 计分 result = 0; 执行 存值.结果(投掷者, obj) { result = 1; }

name: declared parameter does not block tag property
source: fn helper(value) { return value; } fn_tag group { value(helper); }
chinese: 函数 helper(value) { 返回 value; } 函数标签 group { 值(helper); }

name: text styles and click action
source: message.self(text("x") { color = "red"; bold = true; click = run_command("/say hi"); hover = text("y") { italic = false; }; });
chinese: 消息.自身(文本("x") { 颜色 = "red"; 粗体 = 真; 点击 = 运行命令("/say hi"); 悬停 = 文本("y") { 斜体 = 假; }; });

name: data and item methods
source: data.get(entity, self, "x"); data.merge(entity, self, nbt { true = false; }); data.remove(entity, self, "x"); item.override(entity, self, "weapon", with(reward)); item.modify(entity, self, "weapon", "minecraft:test");
chinese: 数据操作.取(实体, 自身, "x"); 数据操作.合并(实体, 自身, 数据 { true = 假; }); 数据操作.移除(实体, 自身, "x"); 物品.覆盖(实体, 自身, "weapon", 用(reward)); 物品.修改(实体, 自身, "weapon", "minecraft:test");

name: compute argument positions
source: score integer = 1; let v = compute(default, integer, "minecraft:test"); let w = compute(entity, integer, float, "minecraft:test"); let b = compute(block, pos(1, 2, 3), integer, "minecraft:test");
chinese: 计分 integer = 1; 令 v = 计算(默认, 整数, "minecraft:test"); 令 w = 计算(实体, integer, 浮点, "minecraft:test"); 令 b = 计算(方块, 坐标(1, 2, 3), 整数, "minecraft:test");

name: score operation only translates operation argument
source: objective add = "dummy"; scoreboard.operation(self, add, add, self, add);
chinese: 目标 add = "dummy"; 计分板.运算(自身, add, 加上, 自身, add);

name: scoreboard command chain spellings
source: scoreboard.objectives.modify.rendertype(obj, hearts); scoreboard.objectives.modify.numberformat(obj, fixed(text("x") { bold = true; })); scoreboard.players.display.numberformat(self, obj, styled("{}"));
chinese: 计分板.目标集.修改.渲染类型(obj, 爱心); 计分板.目标集.修改.数字格式(obj, 固定(文本("x") { 粗体 = 真; })); 计分板.玩家分数.显示.数字格式(自身, obj, 样式("{}"));
